parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123558' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles
